articles.content_en: Article 6: Where a person commits the act specified in Article 338 of the Criminal Law, if the actor admits guilt and accepts punishment, actively restores the ecological environment, and effectively carries out compliance rectification, he or she may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment; if the circumstances of the crime are minor, the case may be not prosecuted or the actor may be exempted from criminal punishment; if the circumstances are obviously minor and the harm is not great, the act shall not be treated as a crime.

Article 7: Where a person, without a hazardous waste business license, engages in the business activities of collecting, storing, utilizing, or disposing of hazardous waste and seriously pollutes the environment, the person shall be convicted and punished according to the crime of environmental pollution; where the act also constitutes the crime of illegal business operation, the person shall be convicted and punished according to the provisions providing the heavier punishment.
Where a person commits the act specified in the preceding paragraph, and there are no circumstances of excessively discharging pollutants, illegally dumping pollutants, or otherwise illegally causing environmental pollution, the act may be deemed as illegal business operation with obviously minor circumstances and little harm, and shall not be considered a crime; where the act constitutes another crime such as producing or selling counterfeit or substandard products, the person shall be punished as that other crime.

Article 8: Where a person, knowing that another person has no hazardous waste business license, provides hazardous waste to that person or entrusts that person to collect, store, utilize, or dispose of hazardous waste, and the environment is seriously polluted, the person shall be treated as a joint offender.

Article 9: Where a person, in violation of state provisions, discharges, dumps, or disposes of pollutants containing toxic, radioactive, or infectious disease pathogen substances, and the act simultaneously constitutes the crime of environmental pollution, the crime of illegally disposing of imported solid waste, the crime of throwing dangerous substances, or other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished according to the provisions providing the heavier punishment.

Article 12: Where an actor who commits the relevant acts specified in this Interpretation is not prosecuted or is exempted from criminal punishment, and administrative punishment, disciplinary action for government affairs, or other sanctions are necessary, the case shall be transferred to the relevant competent authority for handling according to law. The relevant competent authority shall promptly notify the people's procuratorate and the people's court of the handling result.

Article 13: Where a unit commits a crime specified in this Interpretation, the directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible personnel shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the conviction and sentencing standards specified in this Interpretation, and the unit shall be fined.

Article 14: Monitoring data collected by environmental protection administrative authorities and their affiliated monitoring institutions in the process of administrative law enforcement may be used as evidence in criminal proceedings.
Data obtained by public security organs, independently or jointly with environmental protection administrative authorities, through extracting and testing pollutant samples may be used as evidence in criminal proceedings.

Article 15: For wastes listed in the National Catalogue of Hazardous Wastes, identification may be made based on evidence such as the source of the substance involved, the production process, the defendant's confession, witness testimony, and approved or filed environmental impact assessment documents, pollutant discharge permits, and pollutant discharge registration forms, in conjunction with written opinions issued by environmental protection administrative authorities, public security organs, and other authorities.
The quantity of hazardous waste shall be determined based on the facts of the case, comprehensively considering evidence such as the defendant's confession, the production technology, material consumption, and energy consumption of the enterprise involved, and approved or filed environmental impact assessment documents.

Article 16: Where a specialized issue concerning environmental pollution involved in a case is difficult to determine, the determination shall be made based on the appraisal opinion issued by an appraisal institution, or a report issued by an institution designated by the environmental protection administrative authority under the State Council or the public security department, in conjunction with other evidence.

Article 18: Where a person, without a hazardous waste business license and for the purpose of profit, extracts substances from hazardous waste as raw materials or fuel, and there are circumstances of excessively discharging pollutants, illegally dumping pollutants, or otherwise illegally causing environmental pollution, the act shall be deemed as "illegal disposal of hazardous waste".

Article 19: For the purpose of this Interpretation, "within two years" means the time interval calculated from the effective date of the administrative punishment for the first illegal act to the date of committing the corresponding act again.
For the purpose of this Interpretation, "key pollutant-discharging unit" means a key monitored enterprise or other unit that shall install and use automatic pollutant discharge monitoring equipment, as determined according to law by the environmental protection administrative authority of a people's government at or above the level of a city divided into districts.
For the purpose of this Interpretation, "illegal gains" means all illegal income obtained and obtainable from committing the acts specified in Articles 229, 338, and 339 of the Criminal Law.
For the purpose of this Interpretation, "losses of public or private property" include the actual value of property directly damaged or reduced as a result of committing the acts specified in Articles 338 and 339 of the Criminal Law, expenses incurred from necessary and reasonable measures taken to prevent the spread of pollution and eliminate pollution, and emergency monitoring expenses for handling environmental emergencies.
For the purpose of this Interpretation, "without a hazardous waste business license" means not having obtained a hazardous waste business license, or exceeding the business scope of the hazardous waste business license.

Article 20: This Interpretation shall come into force on August 15, 2023. After this Interpretation comes into force, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Environmental Pollution (Fa Shi [2016] No. 29) shall be repealed simultaneously; where previously issued judicial interpretations are inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.

title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Environmental Pollution
